name: conduit-mods
description: Colin's Claude Code mods: eight from Ben AI's benai-mods set, plus Conduit's own

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, above the prompt. When a big chat goes cold, offers a handoff to a fresh chat. Keep warm pings the cache in the background so it does not go cold

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: A side pane, In this chat, that lists the to-do list, connectors, context files and skills this chat used

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: At 250k tokens, offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat, shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a new chat with it. Logs every run to ~/.claude/handoffs/handoff.log and saves a draft first

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: Helper Desk: a purple task progress bar above the prompt that moves as each to-do item is done, and a side pane with one live card per subagent

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: A Mods pane that finds every mod on this computer by itself, also the ones installed from a marketplace, turns each one on or off in every chat, and opens the side-pane ones

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: When you correct Claude, offers to save the fix as a lasting rule in CLAUDE.md or in a rules folder you choose

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: /screen-share draws emails, phone numbers, money amounts and names as shaded bars on screen for recording, while Claude still reads the real data
